strategies.name: Detection of Standard Application Layer Protocol

analytics.name: Analytic 1931
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Domain Name System (DNS) queries from Industrial Control System (ICS) host Internet Protocol (IP) addresses to external resolvers for domains not associated with any approved ICS vendor, particularly domains exhibiting Domain Generation Algorithm (DGA)-like patterns. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

tuning.description: Allowlist of legitimate vendor/business domains for application-layer protocol traffic.
Inventory of ICS hosts whose role does not require external application-layer connectivity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2155
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux service processes initiating outbound application-layer protocol connections to ports/destinations outside the approved communication matrix. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

analytics.name: Analytic 2223
analytics.guidance: Near-real-time connection monitoring identifies an embedded field device or gateway initiating outbound connections on standard application-layer protocol ports to destinations outside the expected Industrial Control System (ICS) communication baseline. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity. This analytic is implementable from session/flow metadata (endpoints, ports, protocol/service, timing, bytes); it does not require or claim packet-payload visibility.

OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.
